title: Luke Bible Quiz - Chapter 15
description: Ten questions on Luke 15: the lost sheep, the lost drachma coin and the son who was dead and is alive again.

questions.text: What did the Pharisees and the scribes murmur about him?
questions.explanation: They murmured, saying, "This man welcomes sinners, and eats with them."

answers.text: That he breaks the Sabbath
That he refuses to eat with tax collectors
That he teaches only in parables
That he welcomes sinners and eats with them

questions.text: In the parable, how many sheep does the man leave behind to look for the lost one?
questions.explanation: The man with one hundred sheep leaves the ninety-nine in the wilderness and goes after the one that was lost.

answers.text: Fifty-nine
Ninety-nine
Seventy
Ninety-eight

questions.text: What does the woman do when she loses one of her ten drachma coins?
questions.explanation: She lights a lamp, sweeps the house and seeks diligently until she finds it.

answers.text: She asks her neighbors to lend her a coin
She counts the other nine coins again
She lights a lamp and sweeps the house
She waits for the morning light to look

questions.text: What did the younger son ask his father for?
questions.explanation: The younger son asked his father to give him his share of the property, and the father divided his livelihood between them.

answers.text: His share of his father's property
A fattened calf
A goat to celebrate with his friends
Hired servants for his journey

questions.text: What work did the younger son do in the far country?
questions.explanation: He joined himself to one of the citizens of that country, who sent him into his fields to feed pigs.

answers.text: He served as a hired steward
He begged at the city gate
He dug and plowed a vineyard
He fed pigs in the fields

questions.text: What did the father do while his son was still far off?
questions.explanation: While the son was still far off, his father saw him, was moved with compassion, ran, fell on his neck and kissed him.

answers.text: He ran to him, fell on his neck and kissed him
He waited inside the house
He sent a servant out to meet him
He went out to the field to tell the elder son

questions.text: What three things did the father tell his servants to bring for the son?
questions.explanation: The father told the servants to bring the best robe, a ring for his hand and sandals for his feet.

answers.text: Bread, oil and wine
The best robe, a ring and sandals
A goat, a lamp and a coin
A staff, a wallet and a purse

questions.text: What did the elder son hear as he came near to the house?
questions.explanation: The elder son was in the field, and as he came near to the house he heard music and dancing.

answers.text: Weeping and mourning
His father calling him
Music and dancing
The servants arguing

questions.text: What did the elder son complain that his father had never given him?
questions.explanation: He complained that although he had served his father many years, his father had never given him a goat so that he might celebrate with his friends.

answers.text: A goat to celebrate with his friends
A share of the property
The best robe
A fattened calf of his own

questions.text: What did the father answer the elder son about what belongs to him?
questions.explanation: The father said, "Son, you are always with me, and all that is mine is yours."

answers.text: That he would receive a double share
That he must first forgive his brother
That nothing was left to give him
That he is always with him and all that is his is his
